desc: Lapua ammunition is world renowned for accuracy and performance, making use of high quality components and adhering to the strictest of tolerances. Designed for long range and bench rest shooting, Scenar bullets were used to set a world record perfect score in the 300 meter Moscow championship match. Factory testing has resulted in 10-shot groups that averaged 50mm at 300 meters. This ammunition is new production, non-corrosive, in boxer primed, reloadable brass cases.
